messages:
maria: Heads-up — reproducible-builder run in eu-west produced a different image digest and SBOM compared to us-west when we tried to promote. Promotion automation failed the digest check. Need quick sync before we flip the job.
jonah: any logs or example digests? could be signing/attestation mismatch or different layer order.
sam: My hunch: builders are using local cache + timestamps, so two regional builds diverge. We should build once and replicate instead of building per region.
olivia: currently CI tags as `ci-<sha>` then we retag and push per-region. That retag flow ends up re-pushing layers and sometimes re-ordering manifests. We should promote by digest, not retag.
jonah: also we don't currently publish SBOM/provenance as first-class artifacts alongside the image digest. If we attach cosign attestations on digest we can verify promotion safely.
infra-bot: buildkite:builder-runner #4587 finished — published gcr.us-west1/redwood/builder:ci-abc, SBOM uploaded to gs://redwood-sboms/ci-abc.sbom.json 
maria: snippet from failed promote log:
```
> promote-job: pulling image gcr.us-west1/redwood/builder:ci-abc
> manifest digest=sha256:aaa111
> copying to eu: retagged -> pushed -> produced sha256:bbb222
> verification: expected sha256:aaa111 != got sha256:bbb222
```
jonah: yep that shows re-push produced a different digest. two options: 1) copy by digest (registry-to-registry copy) or 2) ensure fully deterministic builds so independent builds match. I prefer copy.
sam: copy-by-digest is best. We can use `crane cp` or registry replication. That is faster and cheaper than rebuilding and avoids digest drift.
olivia: cost question: will cross-region copy incur egress charges? For some registries yes, but still cheaper than multi-arch rebuilds and less error-prone. We should measure.
maria: propose change to pipeline: build once in a central region, publish image+SBOM+attestation, sign with cosign, then use `crane copy` to mirror digests to other region registries; promotion job will verify cosign attestation and SBOM before marking as promoted.
jonah: add reproducibility guards too: set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, remove non-deterministic timestamps in tar, pin base image by digest, and strip build IDs. That reduces surface for accidental rebuild drift.
sam: quick example command for copy + sign:
```
crane copy gcr.io/redwood/builder@sha256:AAA gcr.eu.redwood/builder@sha256:AAA
cosign sign --key kms://projects/../keys/cosign gcr.io/redwood/builder@sha256:AAA
crane push sbom.json gs://redwood-sboms/sha256-AAA.sbom.json
```
olivia: we also need to gate promotion on vulnerability scan (Trivy) and attestation presence. Otherwise copies propagate bad images.
maria: I'll open a PR to: switch promotion to digest-based copy, upload SBOM + attestation alongside image, add canary verify job that compares digests after copy, and set deterministic build env (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH). Assigning cosign + attestation work to @jonah, registry replication config to @sam.
infra-bot: created issue #3249 — "builder: single-build publish + digest promotion + SBOM/attestations" and linked PR 4721.
devops-cicd: sgtm. one more ask — add an integration test that pulls from each region and validates image digest == source digest before marking promoted. prevents silent drift.
olivia: :thumbsup: will review the PR this afternoon.
